title: Titanium Orifice Plate (Flow Meter)
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for Titanium Orifice Plate (Flow Meter) where formability and corrosion resistance are prioritized over absolute strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, Grade 2 CP-Ti forms a stable TiO₂ passive film that provides immunity to pitting in chloride environments up to 260°C. Its 345 MPa yield strength with 30% elongation makes it ideal for Flow metering orifice plate requiring cold forming or bending without cracking. This rationale is driven by flow metering orifice plate and fat life requirements.
process: CNC machining from plate for instrumentation geometry
TIG welding all-position with 0.5mm corner radius
Passivation DI rinse with 0.5mm corner radius
surfaceTreatment: Pickling HF-HNO3 bath + passivation to restore passive film integrity on welded/seamed process surfaces — tailored for flow metering orifice application
commonFailures: Biofouling accumulation on stagnant surfaces - reduced by smooth surface finish Ra <0.8um and regular CIP — critical for flow metering orifice performance

faq.q: What pH range can Titanium Orifice Plate (Flow Meter) withstand in effluent streams?
faq.a: Grade 2 CP-Ti maintains corrosion rates below 0.05 mm/year across pH 2-12 at 40°C in chloride-containing effluents. For flow metering orifice handling acidic or alkaline waste streams, titanium eliminates the need for polymer linings or acid-resistant brick, reducing maintenance costs by approximately 60% over the 10-year design life.

faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Orifice Plate (Flow Meter) is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Orifice Plate (Flow Meter)?
faq.a: Each Titanium Orifice Plate (Flow Meter) shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for flow metering orifice.
